name: usap
description: Video calls with live translated subtitles

scripts.dev: concurrently -n signal,web,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/signal" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "node scripts/run-ai.mjs"
scripts.dev:https: node scripts/gen-cert.mjs && concurrently -n signal,web,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:https -w apps/signal" "npm run dev:https -w apps/web" "node scripts/run-ai.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/signal && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/signal && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
